title: Q-COST-PROOF-1: record Quniverse D1 rows read and Workers AI neurons daily and discover account resources without hand-holding
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** daily clock, driver order
**Done check:** grep:deploy/cost-probe.mjs::d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups
**Status:** closed

Quniverse is the test bed on the same Cloudflare account. Measured 2026-11-13 (7 days): qnfo-audit 9.46B D1 rows read, living-paper 1.78B, qnfo-graph 0.38B; all Ultrastable databases under 7M. Build deploy/cost-probe.mjs: GraphQL d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups per database id plus AI neurons, append to ops/cost.jsonl, file a queue item when a database exceeds a threshold held in data. Resource discovery: list account Workers, D1, KV, R2 and diff against doctrine/topology.json (topology --drift), filing undeclared resources as items. The rows-read fix itself belongs to the QNFO D1 thread.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:deploy/cost-probe.mjs::d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups


**Evidence:** closed by the pull request that carries this change
